homeDescription: Home counts as Lived. Former homes stay Lived.
clearTravelMessage: Deletes your places, lists, home, and recovery copies. Keeps settings. Cannot be undone.
resetMessage: Restores default settings. Keeps your travel data.
resetAppMessage: Deletes all app data, settings, and recovery copies. Cannot be undone. Backups saved outside the app and iOS permissions stay.
appDescription: Your travels and wishlist, saved on your iPhone.
